notes.title: NPC Behaviours FTW!
notes.notes: [previewyoutube="caj4pkXq3Zc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]A small new update that brings some bugfixes, but also better NPC behaviour: when you need to follow Ramius (or any other NPC later in the game), s/he will wait for & turn towards you if you are not fast enough, and also will continue walking if you are too fast.[/p][p]Before, NPC's would simply stop moving and wouldn't do anything, as soon as Zak was too far away.[/p][p]Small but subtle change, that makes the NPC's behaviour feel much better :)[/p][p][/p][p]Kudos and thanks to @RetroX for pointing out the bugs, and motivation in general! ;) [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Changelog[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ramius/NPC's wait correctly for player (turn around, continue walking if player is faster)[/p][/*][*][p]Ramius: added some dialogue when player activated 1st obelisk[/p][/*][*][p]junker end-boss: show shield indicator a little bit longer before starting shield[/p][/*][*][p]fixed: dialogue UI was interfering with player picture[/p][/*][*][p]fixed: wrong camera when player entered the main map (camera targetted towards air con)[/p][/*][*][p]fixed: trigger enemies sequence even if player leaves first dungeon through entrance (if obelisk quest is unfinished)[/p][/*][*][p]fixed: after air con repair - snake spawn FX[/p][/*][*][p]fixed: after air con repair - snakes do attack[/p][/*][*][p]fixed: wind animation on plants[/p][/*][*][p]fixed: Zak didn't pick up the spaceship keycard if "skipped prologue"[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo-Version 0.6.9b: FX- & Sound-Update
notes.notes:
Hello there,

with the newest update, I optimized many of the FX and sounds - lots of player feedback for the Laser Katana© :)

Kudos and thank you <3 Emanuel Fitz for creating the new hit sound, which clearly is much "smoother" and fits the other weapon sounds better... but most important, it will not distract the player anymore... the old sound was taken from a SFX asset pack from the Unity asset store, and actually sounded much more like a laser gun shot. Which after a while, drove me nuts :D

Here is the changelog for version 0.6.9b:

[list]
[*] added new Laser Katana© hit sound (created by Emanuel Fitz https://www.emanuelfitz.de/game-audio)
[*] added new endboss destruction FX
[*] added new endboss hit FX
[*] optimized "enemy disappears" sound (now more of a "plopp" sound :))
[*] optimized pacing of "defeat an endboss" sequence (camera, sound, FX)
[*] optimized player min. movement animation
[*] optimized item descriptions & tutorial pacing - don't tell the player too much too early ;)
[*] optimized pacing of some dialoges (Ramius, Uncle Bill)
[*] optimized: NPC's don't rotate towards player if they don't see him (Uncle Bill, Trader Jane)
[*] fixed: no more "pick-up" animation while player is dashing
[*] fixed: cardbox texturing / model (in the farms' basement)
[*] fixed: sometimes enemies stop being animated, and wander around like statues :)
[*] fixed: Zack would not unsheath his Laser Katana© during upgrade animation
[*] lots of engine & SDK updates
[/list]

Thanks for your attention,
Greetings
Denzi <3

PS: I had the honour to be interviewed by Christen from [i]Indiegame Origin[/i] - thank you, it was a pleasure! <3 :)

👉 [url=https://indiegameorigin.com/blog/space-laser-katanas-how-tales-of-the-laser-knights-came-to-be]https://indiegameorigin.com/blog/space-laser-katanas-how-tales-of-the-laser-knights-came-to-be[/url]

notes.title: Epic new Animated Intro!!!

We finally got rid of the ugly old intro with the "wall-of-text" (who reads that stuff anyhooch?)! 

[i]Nadim "I'm not rude" Arnaout[/i] took the time to create an epic [b]animated intro[/b] video, which totally reminds me of the good old "Saturday morning cartoons" like Brave Starr, Saber Rider, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles ... and of course, my biggest inspiration - Captain Future!

enjoy the intro & have fun with the new version! ːsteamthisː

"Welcome to Mos Spicey" Update!

Another huge update... this time I updated the graphics completely, desaturated the environment colors, and made the whole world look more slick. I especially enjoy such subtle impacts like the "dungeon light" that surrounds the player while inside dungeons: it makes the whole scenery look much more dynamic, and the glowing eyes of the new enemy models are popping out even more.

I also was not sure if I should add the ability to swim because I didn't see the need to do it; now that I implemented it in some kind of rage coding ;) I am super happy with the results... it's fun to swim, and also not overused - only 2 level at the moment.

Denzi

notes.title: Version 0.6.6: The biggest update!
notes.notes:
This update took a little bit longer, since I totally underestimated switching from Unity's Built-In Renderpipeline to the "newer" Universal Render Pipeline (URP) ... lots of changes to materials, lots of "glow" settings to set (HDR glow incoming ;)) ... lots of testing ... lots of bugfixing ....

I also added the new Laser Katana sound created by Emanual Fitz (ef.sound) - kudos to him, because the sound makes the Laser Katana feel so much more characteristic ... love it <3

A.I. got a lot of improvements, from movement to animation to A.I. behaviour - I also added a new enemy: the Sandworm, only to be found in the newly created area "the Desert of Death"..

So, be prepared for the biggest update so far ... here is the changelog for version 0.6.6.

[list]
[*] extended main world, adjusted some levels, changed some textures
[*] audio: added real Laser Katana sounds (including new deactivation sound)
[*] visuals: outline on objects the player can interact with / pick up, and on NPC's the player can talk to
[*] visuals: player & enemies are faded out if falling into pit / to death
[*] visuals: new loading UI animation (in the right bottom of the screen: animated player running)
[*] visuals: smoothed dialogue fading and transitions
[*] cutscenes: added missing dialogue for Uncle Bill if you meet him after repairing the air con
[*] cutscenes: adjusted spaceship "open hatch" sequence
[*] animations: player and NPC's rotation is animated
[*] animations: added player "terrified" animation during snake attack (meeting Ramius)
[*] animations: new player idle animations, smoother transition to default animation 
[*] animations: added player falling animation
[*] animations: added player dodge forward animation
[*] animations: added animations for female NPC's (e.g. Trader Jane)
[*] animations: smoothed animations for some enemies (Mwarf, Pentapod, Murgl & Junker)
[*] AI: added new Sandworm enemy (only to be found in the Desert of Death)
[*] AI pathfinding: units reach destination more precise (before they would sometimes jitter back and forth)
[*] AI movement / rotation: lots of changes make all AI units move much smoother, and with their own characteristics
[*] AI balancing: decreased junker health (from 125 to 100)
[*] input: better player reaction with gamepad sticks (max speed at 1/2 stick movement)
[*] input: player rotation is applied smoothly if not moving (or moving slowly)
[*] graphics: Unity update, migrated from old Built-In Render Pipeline to Universal Render Pipeline (URP)
[*] graphics: enabled real HDR colors, adding more fancy glow to special FX 
[*] graphics: added fancier planet clouds and halo
[*] graphics: added new volumetric fog FX
[*] graphics: items in inventory/tutorials are rendered correctly, without wrong light impacts and artifacts
[*] physics: better action selection (player points towards action)
[*] physics: obelisks can now be activated from any direction
[*] physics: player can throw objects by holding the "drop" button
[*] physics: carrying objects is more stable
[*] physics: player drops objects if they collide with other objects (i.e. cannot be moved into position anymore)
[*] fixed: player actions would be cancelled randomly before execution (hold button)
[*] fixed: random player rotation after actions were finished
[*] fixed: wrong outline sizes on enemies, NPC's and lots of other objects
[*] fixed: broken outline on Zak's hair
[/list]

notes.title: Release / Hotfixes
notes.notes:
After 4 years of development I decided that it was time to go live with the Demo Version... it's been a wild ride, and at some point you have to let go your baby :D <3

In the Demo you can play parts of the very first quest, on the first planet of five that you will visit in the full game. And after 5 days of being online, I was already able to create a Community Update with lots of fixes... thanks for all the feedback, especially for reporting all those nasty bugs :)

Have a nice weekend!


Changelog:

- increased quality of many textures
- added lots of quests descriptions (so that player should always have at least a rough direction where to go)
- tutorials: now indicate how often an action must be done (e.g. "Dodge towards any direction (0/3)" )
- tutorials: questlog tutorial is now shown in 2nd room, to help players find their way immediately
- map: better readability of icons, especially map icons
- map: houses now have their own icons
- map: more positions have a specific name (instead of only "Entrance")
- Katana Upgrade UI: added players' current spice and machine parts count
- added "Prologue" and "Chapter 1" UI
- AI bugfix: NPCs, enemies (in cut scenes, even the player) sometimes stopped rotating towards their target
